creator: kevinfremon
title: Demo of a 'board of directors' feature in the Trillion agent: named advisor personas (Gary Vee, Daymond John, Seth Godin, Julie Zhuo) debate a marketing question and return a verdict; prompt at hellotrillion.ai/p/the-board

tools.name: Trillion (creator's Jarvis-style agent)
tools.detail: Local web UI at localhost:7777; voice-triggered 'Hey Trillion, let's have a board meeting'; GitHub repo waitlist 3,500+

tools.name: The Board prompt
tools.detail: HELLOTRILLION.AI/P/THE-BOARD — the shared prompt to build your own board

claims: Over 3,500 members on the GitHub repo waitlist
Board personas programmed in: Gary Vaynerchuk, Daymond John, Julie Zhuo, Seth Godin (and others); each gives its own opinion with a confidence level and cited sources, then a final verdict
Idea credited to a friend named Eric

Example verdict on 'how to market Trillion given 3,500 waitlist members': don't market the raw number; find who is behind it; hunt the obsessive minority who evangelize; put money behind organic posts that already converted; turn 5-6 named power users into co-sign stories; one sentence/one person/one problem before writing copy; time-box to a week, pull GitHub activity, interview 5-8 loudest users, then return to revenue
how_to_steps: Define a set of advisor personas (real public figures' known philosophies) inside your agent
Trigger a 'board meeting' with a business question (voice or text)
Each persona produces an opinion with a confidence rating and sources; the system synthesizes a final verdict with concrete next actions
Copy the prompt from hellotrillion.ai/p/the-board to build your own
on_screen_only: Trillion web UI at localhost:7777 with a glowing network-graph board visualization
Persona card: 'Julie Zhuo — Design Craft & Product Judgment — MEDIUM CONFIDENCE — 2 sources cited'
Board members visible: Gary Vaynerchuk, Seth Godin, Daymond John, Julie Zhuo (plus more avatars)
Board question text: 'We now have over 3,500 members on the Hello Trillion GitHub repo (the OSS release of Trillion). How should we best market Trillion now, given this milestone?'
Verdict panel: 'Board unanimously says don't market the number, find out who's behind it first...'
Bottom bar showing spend counters (e.g. '$45,492', '$36.13', '513 TH/s') — unclear meaning
cta: Steal the prompt at hellotrillion.ai/p/the-board; join the GitHub waitlist; 'Who's on your board?'

relevance.why: Same 'advisor council' idea as bengusberg's video but with named-expert personas, confidence levels and citations; the verdict format (time-boxed, concrete actions) is a useful template for a solo founder's decision-making.

implement_score.why: Fetch the shared prompt and wrap it as a Claude Code skill; an hour at most. Skip the fancy UI. Value depends on whether persona fidelity adds anything over a generic skeptic/operator council.

verify: Does hellotrillion.ai/p/the-board actually host the prompt and under what license?
Trillion itself is unreleased (waitlist); the visualization is not reproducible
Hallucination risk: personas 'citing sources' for what Gary Vee or Seth Godin would say
Whether using real people's names as personas has any reputational/legal issue in a product
